<h1 class="inbl">Ruan BOTHA <img src="/img/logo/drapeaux/petit/afs.png" alt="South Africa Flag" /> 34 years, Lock</h1>
<div id="bio">
<div class="photo">
<img src="/img/joueurs/default.png" alt="Photo Ruan BOTHA" />
</div>
<div class="bio">
<h2>Bio</h2>
<p>
<b>Ruan BOTHA</b> is a 34-year-old <a href="/players/south-africa">South African rugby player</a>
standing at 2.05&nbsp;m tall (6&nbsp;ft 9&nbsp;in)
and
weighing in at 120&nbsp;kg
(18&nbsp;st 12.55&nbsp;lb; 264.55&nbsp;lb)
, who currently plays for <a href="/club/tokyo-bay/">Kubota Spears Funabashi Tokyo-Bay</a> in Japan as lock.
</p>
</div>
<div class="parcours">
<h2>Career</h2>
<ul>
<li>Stormers (2013 - 2015)</li>
<li>Sharks (2015 - 2019)</li>
<li>London Irish (2019 - 2020)</li>
<li>Kubota Spears Funabashi Tokyo-Bay (2021 - 2026)</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
